estimate-from-rate-file.name: Estimate From Rate File
estimate-from-rate-file.description: Draft the estimate from their rate file plus the inventory they stored.

inventory-completeness.name: Inventory Completeness
inventory-completeness.description: Compare the inventory sheet to rooms, PBO versus CP codes, and the high-value list if their rule requires one.

high-value-list-check.name: High Value List Check
high-value-list-check.description: Check whether their high-value form is present when their rule or estimate PDF says it is required.

materials-list.name: Materials List
materials-list.description: Pull carton and crate quantities from their materials sheet and the inventory tally they named as live.

crew-day.name: Crew Day
crew-day.description: Build the day list from their roster plus the calendar jobs they already booked.

truck-calendar.name: Truck Calendar
truck-calendar.description: List unit, date, and job from their truck calendar. Flag two firsts on one truck and jobs with no unit.

delivery-window-list.name: Delivery Window List
delivery-window-list.description: List dest windows and spreads from their calendar file and job sheet.

weigh-ticket-pack.name: Weigh Ticket Pack
weigh-ticket-pack.description: Index scale slips they stored: tare, gross, net, unit, date. Never invent a pound.

claims-routing.name: Claims Routing
claims-routing.description: Assemble the claim row, named photos, and BOL number if present. Route to the owner they named.
